content: सौगन्धिक {%a.%} (-का|-की|{%f.%}) Sweet-scented, fragrant. .{@-कः@} .²1 A dealer in perfumes, perfumer. .²2 Sulphur. .²3 A sexually weak man (who is stimulated by the smell of the female organs). .²4 A kind of worm infesting the bowels. .{@-कम्@} .²1 The white water-lily; गृहेषु नानोपवनामलाम्भःसरस्सु सौगन्धिककाननेषु <ls>Bhāg. 9. 6. 45</ls>. .²2 The blue lotus. .²3 A kind of fragrant grass (कत्तृण). .²4 A ruby.
